notes: logit_bias is documented as unsupported; penalties and stop are refused by reasoning models only, which is model-specific. total_tokens includes reasoning tokens. The error body is undocumented. Image generation uses the xai-images media wire: https://docs.x.ai/developers/rest-api-reference/inference/images. Realtime evidence added 2026-10-27: the voice agent API is a WebSocket at wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime?model=<model> with Bearer auth, following the OpenAI Realtime event shape (session.created and conversation.created on connect, session.update from the client, response.done carrying usage). Frames in realtime.frames.json are schema-built offline fixtures from those documented event names, not captured traffic
